reason: Close Facebook Personal Messenger post-login production behavior without reopening the already proven real username/password login question. Adopt mature mautrix/meta as the Meta Messenger protocol/login/session/send/receive/recovery authority behind Synapse/Matrix, use the official matrix-js-sdk only as the Node client-side Matrix synchronization/timeline SDK where Yance must consume or send canonical Matrix events, and reuse Yance's existing AccountManager, platform adapter ports, canonical message/account projections, SendQueue and durable SESSION_RESTORE authority. Retire the experimental isolated-browser-session driver and its persisted profile. No browser automation, DOM scraping, cookie harvesting, second protocol transport, second retry queue, or hand-written Matrix /sync state machine is authorized.

evidence.restartRootCause: AppRuntimeComposition already exposes startup.requestSessionRestores, but backend/server.js does not invoke it; normal persisted accounts therefore do not get a fresh durable SESSION_RESTORE request merely because the app restarted.
evidence.capabilityRootCause: platformCapabilities currently keys Facebook capability truth only by platform while Facebook Page and Personal Messenger have different transports and capability contracts.

retireOrAvoid: Retire facebook-personal-messenger-experimental as the active Personal Messenger driver.
Retire isolated-browser-session as the Personal Messenger isolation/session authority and forward-migrate stale persisted driver metadata.
Delete/retire the experimental browser adapter production path rather than keeping it as fallback.
Do not use Selenium, Playwright, browser DOM automation, cookie harvesting or Yance-owned Meta protocol/login/session code.
Do not hand-write a Matrix /sync, pagination, retry, reconnect or client-state engine; use matrix-js-sdk.
Do not create a second message database, retry queue, scheduler, canonical identity engine or SendQueue.
Do not modify Facebook Page Chatwoot ownership except the regression assertion needed to prove Page remains isolated from Personal Messenger.

mandatoryFailureFirstContracts: The first implementation commit changes only the three approved dedicated tests and must fail on current main because Personal Messenger still resolves to facebook-personal-messenger-experimental/isolated-browser-session, no mautrix/meta runtime pin/config is present, and no production Matrix SDK adapter exists.
Failure-first must prove that previously successful real username/password login is inherited evidence and must not require repeating login; tests target post-login production closure.

Failure-first must prove stable mautrix/meta v0.2607.0 exact pin and native messenger-lite flow, and must reject candidate-only messenger-lite-android as a V1 production dependency until a stable upstream release exists.

Failure-first must prove that no browser automation, DOM scraping, cookie harvesting, direct Meta protocol client, duplicate retry queue, or hand-written Matrix /sync loop becomes production authority.
Failure-first must prove driver/account-kind-aware capabilities: Facebook Page retains Chatwoot capability truth while Personal Messenger exposes only capabilities backed by mautrix/meta/Matrix.

Failure-first must prove startup requests fresh durable SESSION_RESTORE for eligible persisted accounts through the existing startup.requestSessionRestores command rather than adapter-local reconnect timers.
Failure-first must prove canonical ingress identity/message idempotency and duplicate suppression across replay/reconnect, including Matrix event replay and stable upstream message identity.

Failure-first must prove send, attachments, history/backfill, typing, read receipt, logout/session expiry and multi-account isolation remain within existing canonical account/message and durable egress boundaries.
Failure-first must prove historical migrations are unchanged and only the new schema-24 migration moves stale persisted Personal Messenger driver/isolation metadata forward.
